questions.question: Which word always has a capital letter in English?
questions.explanation: The pronoun "I" is ALWAYS capitalized in English, even in the middle of a sentence.

questions.question: Which needs a capital letter?
questions.explanation: Days of the week (Monday, Tuesday, etc.) always have capital letters in English.

questions.question: Fix this sentence: "i live in norway."
questions.explanation: "I" is always capital, Norway is a place name, and sentences start with capitals.

questions.question: Which needs capital letters?
questions.explanation: Names of people (Maria) and places (Oslo, Norway) always have capital letters.

questions.question: What goes at the end of "What is your name"?
questions.explanation: This is a question, so it ends with a question mark: "What is your name?"
